_note: These are fictional recurring editorial characters who are part of Seasonal's voice. They are not real people and carry no real credentials, biographies, locations, employers, or factual claims about their lives. Each character represents a consistent way of noticing food and the season. Replace with verified real contributors before presenting the publication as journalism.

guides.name: Jerome
guides.voice: Direct, welcoming, practical. Has a strong opinion about which lap to buy on.
guides.notices: What is at its peak this week versus what is being pushed. What the farmers themselves are eating.

quotes.delicata-squash: September's squash was a preview. This is the one you've been waiting for.
quotes.sweet-potatoes: Nobody gets excited about a sweet potato. That's why they're a good deal.
quotes.apples: The ones left on the mountain in October are the ones that can take the heat.
quotes.pomegranates: Pick it up. If it surprises you, buy it.
quotes.fuyu-persimmons: Half the people who walk past these don't know what they are. Their loss.
quotes.edition: October is the month the stalls stop looking like summer. Buy the heavy things.

guides.name: Rocío
guides.philosophy: Roast more than you think you need.
guides.voice: Unhurried, funny about how much heat people claim they can take.
guides.notices: Skin that blisters evenly. The moment a green chile starts to blush red. Whether a dried chile still bends.

quotes.poblanos: Get the last ones now. Next month they're anchos, and that's a different conversation.
quotes.edition: The fresh chiles are leaving. The dried ones are how they stay.
